messages:
infra-alert-bot: :rotating_light: S3 alert — gpu-pool-47 container restart rate spiked above 5/min. Reason: CUDA OOM during prefill (large context windows). Affected model: redwood-open-30b-quant. Estimated failed requests ~6% in the last 5m. Paging oncall: @riley @alejandro

riley: I'm on it — pulling node and container logs from gpu-pool-47 now. Which route/service is hottest?

infra-alert-bot: Hot routes: /v1/generate (route-id: r-gen-14), /v1/chat (r-chat-03). Top offending requests have prompt lengths > 150k characters (large context). Logs collected at /var/logs/runtime/gpu-pool-47/oom-2876543208.log

riley: got logs. small excerpt below:
```
[2026-03-15T12:01:08Z] runtime: container=worker-7 restart reason=OOM during prefill
[2026-03-15T12:01:09Z] cuda: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T12:01:09Z] stack: runtime/prefill.go:137 allocateKVCache
[2026-03-15T12:01:09Z] request: id=req-98a2 route=r-gen-14 tokens=131072
```
Looks like prefill allocate path exhausts device memory when request token count > ~110k.

simone: Hypothesis: long-context prefill + big batch sizes + KV cache allocation -> surpasses quantized model working set. Quick mitigation options (in order):
1) Block/trim prefill for requests > X tokens via route guard (fast).
2) Disable prefetch/prefill for risky routes (runtime flag).
3) Shift % traffic to smaller model variant (13b).
4) Reduce max_batch_size and enable aggressive KV eviction.

simone: To patch route config quickly (example):
```
# set max prefill tokens to 32k for r-gen-14
kubectl exec -n inference svc/route-config -- sh -c '\n  jq \
    ".routes[\"r-gen-14\"].limits.max_prefill_tokens = 32768" /etc/runtime/routes.json > /tmp/routes.json && \
  mv /tmp/routes.json /etc/runtime/routes.json && \
  kill -HUP 1\n'
```

riley: Applying that now — patching r-gen-14 and r-chat-03 to max_prefill_tokens=32768 and setting PREFETCH=false for those workers. Patching with `kubectl patch` and rolling a 1-pod restart to pick up flags.

riley: Applied patch to r-gen-14 and r-chat-03. rolling restart of 2 pods (worker-7, worker-9) initiated.

devon: Also recommend immediate traffic split: route 30% -> redwood-open-13b-quant to soak large contexts. CLI to change split: `redwoodctl traffic set r-gen-14 --split redwood-open-30b-quant=70,redwood-open-13b-quant=30`. Lower memory pressure and keep latency acceptable for critical customers.

riley: Ran traffic split command, scaled down max_batch_size to 4 on the 30b pods, and enabled soft-kv-eviction. Monitoring restarts.

infra-alert-bot: Metric update: container restarts per minute (gpu-pool-47): 12 -> 4 -> 1 over last 6 minutes. Memory pressure metric on host-47: 92% -> 78% -> 64%.

maya-support: Customer impact note: Support ticket #20412 — several tenants (acct-338, acct-992) reported 500s on batch generation jobs between 12:02–12:20 UTC. We estimate partial degradation, some requests retried successfully. Draft status update ready, please confirm affected window and cause before sending.

simone: Additional runtime guard I'd enable if restarts don't fully stop: reduce KV cache retention to 1 step for prefills and set runtime ENV `KV_EVICTION_POLICY=aggressive`, and lower bench max_batch_size globally to 8. Command to toggle on cluster: `kubectl set env ds/worker KV_EVICTION_POLICY=aggressive --namespace=inference`

riley: Current status: restarts have fallen to baseline. Rolling restart completed for the two pods. Traffic split active (30% -> 13b). Will continue to watch for 30m. Handoff summary -> @alejandro (night oncall):
- Issue: CUDA OOM during prefill causing container restart on gpu-pool-47
- Impact window: 2026-03-15T12:01:00Z -> ongoing (mitigated, last restart at 2026-03-15T12:10:12Z)
- Actions taken: patched r-gen-14 & r-chat-03 to max_prefill_tokens=32768, PREFETCH=false; reduced max_batch_size; traffic split 70/30 -> 30b/13b; enabled soft-kv-eviction on 30b pods
- Outstanding: monitor restarts for 30m, confirm CS message, consider longer-term fixes (model-level memory caps, compile-time OOM protections, prefill throttling)
- If restarts spike: escalate to runtime-eng (simone/devon) and flip traffic to 100% 13b until fixed

alejandro: taking over — thanks @riley. I'll hold the traffic split and keep aggressive eviction for now. Will check GPU errors for noisy neighbor patterns and coord with infra if host needs evacuation. I'll also kick a nightly job to collect full heap dumps for simone/devon.

customer-success: Draft for affected customers (ready to send once you confirm exact window):
"We experienced elevated errors on text-generation endpoints caused by large-context requests triggering GPU memory exhaustion. We mitigated the issue by limiting prefill size and routing some traffic to a lower-memory model. Impact window: 12:01–12:20 UTC. If you saw failed requests please reach out and we can investigate retries/logs. Apologies for the disruption."

riley: Approved. Send after 30m observation completes. If any restarts >3/min notify immediately. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident severity updated to S2. Handoff completed to @alejandro. Please file follow-up ticket for long-term mitigations (prefill token caps, compile-time checks, better per-route telemetry).

alejandro: Acknowledged. I'll open runtime ticket and tag simone/devon. Monitoring — will post any regressions in this thread.

riley: thanks all — closing active page. follow-up: runtime-eng postmortem and config audit in the morning.
